query: 引用准确率和 orphan citation rate 是否能作为智慧情报服务的核心指标？
effective_search_query: 引用准确率 orphan citation rate 智慧情报服务 核心指标

major_issues: 报告结论部分存在过度推断。证据仅表明未发现直接讨论，但结论表述为'无法得出...能作为...结论'，这在逻辑上不够严谨。更准确的表述应是'现有证据未支持...'或'缺乏直接证据表明...'。
第4节'摘要级证据的局限'中，'概念适用范围未界定'的讨论超出了证据范围。证据[1][2][3]并未对'智慧情报服务'的概念范围进行明确界定或与学术评价范畴对比，此部分属于作者推测，应删除或明确指出这是基于证据缺失的推断。
报告结构中的'证据支持的研究方向'（第3节）与审查查询的直接相关性较弱。虽然基于证据推导，但主要回答'智能技术如何应用于情报服务'，而非'特定指标是否适合作为核心指标'。建议将此节精简或融入其他部分，以更紧密地围绕查询问题。
citation_issues: 证据[4]的引用（第2节'人工智能被认为是实现当代组织运营变革的关键'）虽然大意相符，但原文关键主张是'Artificial intelligence is key to achieving persuasive operational transformations in contemporary organizational set-ups, implying its relevance to intelligence services.' 报告表述简化了'implying its relevance to intelligence services'这一重要限定，可能略微强化了其与情报服务的直接关联。
证据[5][7][8]在报告中被概括为'利用多智能体深度强化学习等技术解决...问题'，引用准确。但需注意，证据[5]的方法论明确包含'physical layer security (PLS) technique and spectrum sharing architecture'，报告概括时未提及此技术细节，虽不影响主要论点，但在严格审查下可视为轻微遗漏。
revision_instructions: 修正结论部分（第5节）的表述，使其严格基于证据缺失的事实，避免绝对化推断。例如，改为：'基于当前摘要级别的证据，未发现将“引用准确率”和“孤儿引用率”作为智慧情报服务核心指标的明确论述或支持。'
删除或重写第4节中'概念适用范围未界定'的段落。若保留，应明确说明这是基于证据中未发现相关讨论的观察，而非证据本身的陈述。
考虑精简或重组第3节'证据支持的研究方向'，使其更直接地服务于对查询问题的分析，例如，指出这些研究方向中可能涉及哪些评估指标，但现有证据未包含文献计量指标。
检查并确保所有引用表述与证据原文关键主张在核心含义上保持一致，特别是证据[4]的引用，可考虑更精确地表述其'暗示相关性'的限定。

top_papers.title: Joint Secure Offloading and Resource Allocation for Vehicular Edge Computing Network: A Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
top_papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
top_papers.abstract: The mobile edge computing (MEC) technology can simultaneously provide high-speed computing services for multiple vehicular users (VUs) in vehicular edge computing (VEC) networks. Nevertheless, due to the open feature of the wireless offloading channels and the high mobility of the vehicles, the security and stability of the offloading process would be seriously degraded. In this paper, by utilizing the physical layer security (PLS) technique and spectrum sharing architecture, we propose a deep reinforcement learning based joint secure offloading and resource allocation (SORA) scheme to improve the secrecy performance and resource efficiency of the multi-user VEC networks, where the VU offloading links share the frequency spectrum preoccupied with the vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication

top_papers.title: Federated Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Resource Allocation of Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communications
top_papers.abstract: Dynamic topology, fast-changing channels and the time sensitivity of safety-related services present challenges to the status quo of resource allocation for cellular-underlaying vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communications. In this paper, we investigate a novel federated multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (FedMARL) approach for the decentralized joint optimization of channel selection and power control for V2V communication. The approach takes advantage of both deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and federated learning (FL), satisfying the reliability and delay requirements of V2V communication while maximizing the transmit rates of cellular links. top_papers.journal: IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications
top_papers.abstract: In next-generation wireless networks, high-mobility unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are promising to provide content coverage, where users can receive sufficient requested content within a given time. Moreover, the complete information based trajectory planning methods are unusable since UAVs cannot obtain prior information on the rapidly changing environment.
